name: water-reminder
description: A friendly character pops up and reminds you to drink water.

commands.title: Water Reminder: Choose Male or Female Character
Water Reminder: Choose Character (image or 3D model)

waterReminder.userName.description: Name shown in the greeting. You are asked for it on first run.

waterReminder.snoozeMinutes.description: Minutes to wait after 'Remind me later'.

waterReminder.noReplySeconds.description: If you don't answer within this many seconds, it counts as NO: the reminder leaves and comes back after snoozeMinutes. 0 keeps it up until you answer.

enumDescriptions: Floating transparent character on top of your screen (Linux, needs python3-gi + WebKit2GTK).

waterReminder.overlayPosition.description: Where the floating character appears on screen.

enumDescriptions: A realistic 3D person with motion-captured animations.
Aqua Runner: curly hair, sweatband, round glasses, teal hoodie.
Lily: glam face, red lips, long side-swept waves, black top, white trousers, white handbag.
waterReminder.characterGender.description: Which built-in character reminds you. You are asked on first run; change it with 'Water Reminder: Choose Male or Female Character'.

waterReminder.character.description: Path to your character: an image with a transparent background (.png/.webp/.gif) or a rigged 3D model (.glb/.gltf, whose animations play automatically). Set it with 'Water Reminder: Choose Character'.

waterReminder.characterModelTurn.description: Degrees to rotate the 3D model if it doesn't face you (e.g. 180).

waterReminder.pauseWhenBusy.description: Don't pop up while you're sharing your screen, using the microphone or camera (a call or meeting), or have Do Not Disturb on (Linux). The reminder waits and shows once you're free.

waterReminder.pauseWhenAway.description: Don't pop up while the screen is locked or you've been away (no keyboard or mouse) for awayMinutes (Linux, GNOME). The reminder shows once you're back.

waterReminder.awayMinutes.description: Minutes without keyboard or mouse activity after which you count as away. 0 only checks for a locked screen.

waterReminder.quietHours.description: No reminders between quietHoursStart and quietHoursEnd (e.g. at night).

waterReminder.quietHoursEnd.description: Hour (0-23) when quiet hours end and reminders start again. 'Pause until tomorrow morning' also resumes at this hour.

waterReminder.glassSizeMl.description: Size of one glass in millilitres, used to show how many litres you've drunk.

waterReminder.theme.description: Colours of the reminder pop-up and the Water Reminder panel.

enumDescriptions: A smaller pop-up character and a tighter panel.
waterReminder.viewMode.description: Size of the reminder pop-up and the Water Reminder panel.
